task.title: Propagate incomplete security checks through strict guards and the flow completion gate
task.description: Make the four RED tests in src/security/guard.test.ts GREEN by fixing src/security/guard.ts only: (1) enforced and ci modes must block (allowed=false) when decision.gate is 'incomplete' (engine evidence unavailable, e.g. HMAC key unreadable), with a constant leak-safe reason; (2) advisory mode keeps allowed=true but preserves the truthful incomplete diagnostics in the decision; (3) formatGuardWarning must not return null for an incomplete decision with zero findings; it must mention 'incomplete'; (4) securityFlowGate must map a stored latest report with gate 'incomplete' (and any unparseable/unrecognized report) to status 'fail' with a constant detail that echoes no raw error text, file path or source bytes; the catch branch must not pretend a verified result. Refresh stale comments in guard.ts that still describe a full no-op / fail-open when the module is disabled: the mandatory deterministic floor (validateSerializedOutput) already applies regardless of advisory settings. Write T27-implementation.md and T27-result.json to the flow artifacts dir. Do not review your own fix.

acceptance_criteria: AC6 (AFC-17): a found violation and an incomplete coverage state are visible at the same time; incomplete is never relabeled as pass.
AC8: no required failed/incomplete check is relabeled PASS; strict (enforced/ci) guards and the strict flow gate refuse incomplete evidence while advisory retains truthful incomplete diagnostics.

Policy fold (policies.md): FAIL on an established threshold violation; INCOMPLETE when a required check is missing/skipped/unparsed/unfinished; strict CI accepts only PASS. The guard test file's 17 tests pass; no raw error, path or content leaks into reasons or details.
constraints: Root /Users/Goodea/goodea/keryx. Read .metaproject/index.md first, then .metaproject/skills/gdskills/orchestration/task-implementer/SKILL.md and .metaproject/rules/core/tdd-workflow.mdc. Code search only via bun src/cli.ts ctx rg; long outputs via bun src/cli.ts ctx run.

Ownership: ONLY src/security/guard.ts and src/security/guard.test.ts. Read service.ts/types.ts but do not edit them: another worker owns service.ts concurrently. If the fix truly needs a runGate change in service.ts, stop and return BLOCKED naming the exact needed change instead of editing.

Keep the existing RED tests unchanged except for genuinely wrong expectations, which must be justified in the report. Do not delete tests. Run: bun src/cli.ts ctx run -- bun test src/security/guard.test.ts src/security/persistence-sinks.test.ts src/security/service.memo.test.ts (the memo test line 162 failure is pre-existing and owned by T29; report it, do not fix it). Then run targeted eslint on guard.ts and bun run typecheck.
No git state changes, no network, no model calls, no global suite, no dependency changes, no flow file edits. Stats disabled.
Return a subagent-result JSON at the artifact_path and reply with STATUS: line first.
